records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Partners
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite welcome email [email:4db19d5f], nurture [email:e1eaf235] and a held onboarding call [calendar:339ffeae]. Customer has never replied and no tickets filed, so engagement signal is weak; Pro plan and attended call give some upside within the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: Following up after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. I know the start of a rollout is easy to put down, so I wanted to check in.

Whenever you're ready, the first step is creating a project in Wrenfield 	a	projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you live.

Best,
Chidi
